output.summary: A low-growing herb probably native to southeastern Asia and now found worldwide. Its creeping stems root at the nodes, while its clover-like leaves may be green or purple and its small yellow flowers close outside direct sunlight. The lemony leaves are edible, but prolonged consumption of large quantities may inhibit calcium absorption.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are eaten or infused as a drink; low doses are advised because prolonged large quantities may inhibit calcium absorption.
